title: Thai-Style Chicken Mince Salad with Mint, Lime and Chilli
summary: A bright, punchy Thai-inspired chicken mince salad with fresh mint, lime, chilli and a salty-savoury dressing. It is light but satisfying for lunch, served warm or at room temperature with crisp lettuce.
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken mince substitute and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains and the mince is lightly browned in places.
Add the garlic, ginger and chilli, then cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and the garlic has softened but not browned.
Stir in the fish sauce, lime juice and brown sugar. Cook for 1 minute, scraping up any browned bits, until the mince is glossy and the dressing smells sharp and savoury.
Take the pan off the heat and let the mince cool for 3–4 minutes so the herbs stay fresh rather than wilt completely.
Toss the warm mince with the red onion, mint and coriander. Taste and season with a pinch of salt and black pepper if needed.
Serve in lettuce leaves with cucumber on the side, spooning over any juices from the pan.
